content.introduction: On the Leverage Shares earnings calendar, companies scheduled to report earnings on October 26, 2026, include Cadence Design Systems (CDNS), and on October 27, 2026, Robinhood Markets (HOOG), PayPal Holdings (PYPG), NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPG), Freeport-McMoRan (FCXG), Boeing Company (BOEG), and Bloom Energy Corporation (BEG). On October 29, 2026, AXT (AXTL) is scheduled. On November 2, 2026, companies like Palantir Technologies (PLTG), ON Semiconductor Corporation (ONG), Fabrinet (FNG), Meta Platforms (AAPE), Cipher Digital (CIFG), Sterling Infrastructure Inc. (STLL), and Energy Fuels Inc (UUUG) are set to report. The sources do not provide information about other dates beyond November 2, 2026.
